About us:

Founded in 2013, Datawrkz is a rapidly growing global digital advertising solutions company with a

strong presence in India, the US, and the UK. Acquired by Nazara Technologies in 2022 and further

strengthened by the acquisition of S&;T in the UK, we continue to expand our global footprint and

capabilities.

Led by industry veterans, Datawrkz partners with advertisers and publishers to solve complex marketing

challenges across industries. We specialize in full-funnel advertising with a strong focus on delivering

measurable outcomes.

Our expertise spans Search, Social, Programmatic, and cutting-edge platform partnerships (including

Google, Meta, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Vizibl, Ignition, and others) enabling us to deliver

innovative, performance-driven solutions.With over a decade of experience, our team of Performance

Specialists combines analytical rigor with deep product knowledge to help mid-market clients and global

brands achieve their marketing goals.

Learn more about us at:

https://datawrkz.com/careers

https://datawrkz.com/company/

https://www.linkedin.com/company/datawrkz/

https://www.mediawrkz.com/

https://www.vizibl.ai/




Role: Software Developer

Key Responsibilities:

Follow due SDLC process for different phases of development-like design, development, unit testing, maintenance
Understand the requirements clearly from Functional specs and future roadmap write and update software design specs for the solution.
Participate and invite peer review for design and coding .
Support the automation requirements of continuous integration and continuous deployments.
Handle customer escalations and special requests in a timely manner
Work with the rest of the team in a professional manner and show ownership and commitment.
Timely delivery of software product releases.
Modular, clean and expandable design/code with Quality of code in terms of robustness, readability and maintainability.
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and high-performance backend applications using Python and Django.
Stay current with relevant technologies and contribute to continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI and Generative AI to improve product capabilities, developer productivity, and business processes.



Skills and Experience:

Mandatory Skills

3-4+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on work with Python and Django
Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript
Experience building and maintaining production-grade RESTful APIs using Django RESTFramework (DRF)
Solid understanding of SQL databases, with working knowledge of NoSQL concepts
Strong grasp of core engineering fundamentals: OOP, MVC, RESTful API design, ORM, authentication/authorization, data structures & algorithms (DSA), and common design patterns
Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews)
Working knowledge of Linux/Unix environments, with exposure to deployment processes and CI/CD pipelines
Strong debugging, analytical, and structured problem-solving abilities
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (e.g., S3, EC2, RDS, CloudFront) for building and deploying cloud-based applications
Familiarity with Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) concepts
Strong ability to quickly learn new technologies and apply structured thinking to complex problems
Experience writing unit and integration tests, with a focus on maintaining code quality



Preferred Skills

Working knowledge of FastAPI and/or Angular
Exposure to AI application development prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, or AI agents
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs and building AI-powered product features
Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools
Understanding of microservices architecture and API gateway patterns
Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical initiatives
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments



Compensation and Benefits:

Medical Insurance Coverage of 3,00,000 for individual, spouse, and kids, with the option to include parents and increase coverage to 5,00,000
Performance-driven compensation with upside linked to revenue/gross margin
Professional development support, including reimbursement for relevant certifications/courses
A flexible, outcome-oriented work culture, supported by a global leadership team
Onsite perks: meals, recreation, and an open, collaborative environment
